paragraphs.text: Possum is a creature type for cards that depict small marsupials that live in trees and have thick fur, a long nose, and a tail without fur.
The type first appeared in Outlaws of Thunder Junction with Rambling Possum .
Large sugar gliders were used as mounts by an unidentified team in the Ghirapur Grand Prix .
Possumfolk are among the various races in Bloomburrow .
In Thunder Junction extremely large possums are used as steeds.
